newsitem.title: JAPAN: LME prices soft in Asia, but sentiment strong.
newsitem.headline: LME prices soft in Asia, but sentiment strong.

text.p: London Metal Exchange copper and aluminium prices were soft in quiet Asian trade on Wednesday but market sentiment remained strong, traders said.
At 0605 GMT, LME benchmark three-month copper was quoted at $2,409/2,414 a tonne, down slightly from $2,410/2,413 at 1800 GMT on Tuesday.
Aluminium was quoted at $1,667/1,671 a tonne, compared to $1,670 at the close of Tuesday's afternoon kerb.
"In principle the market is strong," said one copper trader at a Japanese trading house.
"It might reach $2,404, the high of March 7," he said.
But another copper trader disagreed, saying the metal was nearing its peak as producers from China and the United States had started to place selling orders.
In the aluminium market, traders said the metal was set to head for the next target of $1,700, helped by a strong economy in the United States.
"The dollar has dropped, so it is easier for players from non-dollar currency countries to buy the metal," one trader said. "It may not be that difficult to reach the ($1,700) level," he said.
